svg.title: Swedac ISO 15189
svg.desc: Black Swedac mark with accreditation number placeholder XXXX, Provning and ISO 15189.
svg.metadata: Mark source: https://regelverk.swedac.se/foreskrifter/swedac/stafs-2020-1_ackmarke.svg Layout reference: STAFS 2020:1 consolidated 2026-10-01, Annex 1. 24 by 28 mm is a design size, not a Swedac minimum. This assembled illustration is not an issued accreditation symbol.
